combined_text: We know how breaches happen now. It's not a mystery. Attackers don't hack in. They log in. Infostealer malware grabs everything. Passwords, session cookies, MFA tokens. 54% of ransomware victims had their info sitting inside stealer logs way before they ever got hacked. [...] Attackers only need 48 minutes. But with Flare, you realize things happen within seconds. They have real-time detection, and actually checks against Entra ID whether an account is actually real and active, and it can kill a session before anyone opens a ticket.
reason: This provides a high-value, punchy security insight that works well as a standalone educational short.
